Attached: 1 video

Writing code isn’t the hardest part of software engineering anymore.

The real skill in 2026? Orchestrating an army of #AIagents.

Senior engineers are shifting from writing syntax to leading 5–10 AI agents at once - becoming more product-minded and less focused on coding alone.

Deep technical skills still matter, but knowing how to direct, coordinate, and get the most from AI agents may matter more.

Watch the full talk, with transcript, on InfoQ 👉 https://www.infoq.com/presentations/ai-predictions-2030/

#AI #SoftwareEngineering #InfoQ
